subject: Slightly different results when running the same data/model in new version 4.0.2

messages.author: 01e450a8e83acb13
messages.subject: Slightly different results when running the same data/model in new version 4.0.2
parts:
I updated secr to v4.0.2 and am observing some differences in results from the same model/data inputs under version 3.1.2. For the half normal, hazard rate, and binary signal strength detection functions, the results differ only slightly. However, for the compound half normal or cumulative log normal detection functions, the results are very different. This only seems to happen with multiple sessions. Running single session inputs gives identical results across versions. Is this to be expected with the major rewrite for v4? I didn't see any mention of differences for multiple sessions in the documentation, but wanted to check to try and understand what is going on. 

I am working with acoustic data and binary detection/no detection capture histories across multiple recorders. 

Two examples:

Only slight differences
Ran with version 3.1.2
res.hn.multiSess<-secr.fit(capthist,detectfn=0,start=c(log(50),qnorm(0.8),log(20)),mask=mask,verify=FALSE,trace=FALSE)

        link   estimate  SE.estimate        lcl        ucl
D       log  7.9974215 1.816525e+00  5.1527067 12.4126512
g0    logit  0.9999999 2.873903e-16  0.9999999  0.9999999
sigma   log 21.3430790 2.309188e+00 17.2754821 26.3684116


Ran with version 4.0.2
res.hn.multiSess<-secr.fit(capthist,detectfn=0,start=c(log(50),qnorm(0.8),log(20)),mask=mask,details = list(fastproximity = FALSE), verify=FALSE,trace=FALSE)

       link   estimate  SE.estimate        lcl        ucl
D       log  7.4340499 1.700976e+00  4.7746588 11.5746694
g0    logit  0.9999999 8.039165e-15  0.9999999  0.9999999
sigma   log 22.2879969 2.413045e+00 18.0377643 27.5397104

Major differences
Ran with version 3.1.2
res_chn_allSesh = secr.fit(captHistAllSesh, CL = TRUE, detectfn=3, start=c(qnorm(0.9),log(600), log(40)), mask = make.mask(trapsAllSeshList,buffer = 8000), verify = FALSE)

Ran with version 4.0.2
res_chn_allSesh = secr.fit(captHistAllSesh, CL = TRUE, detectfn=3, start=c(qnorm(0.9),log(600), log(40)), mask = make.mask(trapsAllSeshList,buffer = 8000), details = list(fastproximity = FALSE), verify = FALSE)
       link     estimate SE.estimate           lcl           ucl
g0    logit 5.907125e-03   0.9156145 1.127831e-135  1.000000e+00

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Slightly different results when running the same data/model in new version 4.0.2
parts:
Hello Selene
I can't give a definite answer, but in each case one of the parameters is being estimated at a boundary or is unidentifiable, and erratic results aren't too surprising. It would be illuminating to fix the offending parameter (e.g. fixed = list(g0=1.0)) and see if the remaining estimates are consistent between versions. I can't think of an explanation specific to multi-session data.
Murray
